modeReason: Several top stories clear the relevance threshold on their own merits: Anthropic's self-improvement report (novelty 2 × magnitude 3 × breadth 2 = 12) and the computational-hardness proof (3 × 2 × 2 = 12) both exceed the bar, so today stands alone rather than continuing yesterday's valuation story.
phrase: Election losses are pausing new data centers. One AI lab says its models are improving twice as fast as last year, with no sign of slowing.
phraseAlternatives: Voters just made it harder to build new data centers. Inside one lab, AI already builds faster versions of itself, twice as quickly as before.
A wave of election losses is slowing data center construction. One lab's AI keeps improving itself, twice as fast as last year, brakes or not.
Data centers are hitting political brakes after the elections. One AI lab reports its models improving twice as fast as before, with no brakes at all.

brief.concept: Election losses are stalling new AI data center construction and spending, while inside one lab the AI itself keeps getting better at building AI, twice as fast as a year ago, unbothered by any of it.
brief.metaphor: A half-built data center sits frozen behind a stop sign shaped like a ballot, while across the frame a robot calmly bolts together a faster copy of itself as a speed meter climbs.

cast.who: a half-built datacenter with cranes frozen mid-lift
a small crew of workers standing idle beside a stop sign marked with a ballot symbol
a robot on a lab bench, bolting together a faster, shinier copy of itself
a speed meter behind the robot, its needle climbing fast

brief.composition: Split the frame in two halves with a vertical divider. Left half: a half-built datacenter with frozen cranes and idle workers standing beside a stop sign marked with a ballot symbol — still, quiet, paused. Right half: a lab bench where a small robot bolts together a faster copy of itself, a speed meter needle climbing fast behind it. The contrast is between frozen stillness and quick motion.
brief.alt: On one side, construction workers stand idle at a half-built data center marked with a stop sign showing a ballot symbol. On the other side, a robot bolts together a faster copy of itself while a speed meter climbs quickly.
